title: Flat pullback of an effective Cartier divisor is effective Cartier
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_S$ be an effective Cartier ideal [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal] (a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf which, on the members of some open cover of $S$, is generated by a single nonzerodivisor of the ring of sections) with closed subscheme $D=V(\mathcal I)\subset S$, and let $g:Y\to S$ be a flat morphism of schemes [def-weil-flat-morphism]; let $D_Y=D\times_SY$ be the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] with its projection $q:D_Y\to Y$, and let $\mathcal I_{D_Y}=\ker\bigl(\mathcal O_Y\to q_*\mathcal O_{D_Y}\bigr)\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$ be the ideal sheaf of $q$. Then $\mathcal I_{D_Y}$ is an effective Cartier ideal on $Y$; that is, $D_Y$ is an effective Cartier divisor on $Y$. (Locally: for affine opens $\operatorname{Spec}A\subseteq g^{-1}(\operatorname{Spec}R)$ with $\mathcal I|_{\operatorname{Spec}R}=(t)$, $t\in R$ a nonzerodivisor, $\mathcal I_{D_Y}|_{\operatorname{Spec}A}=(t)A$ and the image of $t$ in $A$ is a nonzerodivisor.)
